note: General engineering knowledge for the site team. Project-specific facts (cable type, cores, terminals, ratings) come only from the approved drawings and cable schedule shown on the page. Standards are named at series level; clause numbers are not verified in this app.

b: Beginner
Начинающий
General-purpose silicon rectifier diode: lets current pass one way and blocks it the other way. In fire-alarm and relay circuits it protects against reverse polarity and relay-coil back-EMF.
Выпрямительный диод общего назначения: пропускает ток в одну сторону и блокирует обратный. В пожарных и релейных цепях защищает от обратной полярности и ЭДС самоиндукции катушки реле.
tech: Cathode is the end with the silver/grey band; anode is the other end.
Multimeter diode test: ~0.5–0.7 V forward, open (OL) reverse. Both directions open = failed open; both ~0 V = shorted.
In a sounder/beacon circuit the diode fixes the direction the device accepts; wrong polarity = device never operates but the loop may still read 'normal'.
Across a DC relay coil the band (cathode) goes to the + side of the coil.
eng: Ratings: 1000 V repetitive reverse voltage, 1 A average forward current, ~1.1 V forward drop, 30 A surge (per manufacturer datasheet).
Flyback use: when the coil is de-energised the stored energy circulates through the diode instead of arcing across the driving contact or damaging a transistor output.
Polarity-supervision use: the panel sends a small reverse current to check the line, then a forward current to operate the device; the diode makes this possible.
Check the drawing before fitting: quantity, position (which terminal) and direction are design data, not a site choice.
chk: No heat damage or cracked body
Leads not shorting to neighbouring terminals
mis: Diode left out because 'the loop works anyway'
Soldered joint instead of terminal connection where the drawing shows a terminal
ref: Project SPBA / fire-alarm wiring drawings (position and quantity)

b: A resistor at the far end of a detector or sounder line gives the panel a known resting current. Open circuit = current drops to zero (fault); short = current rises (fault or alarm). Without it the panel cannot supervise the wiring.
Резистор в конце шлейфа задаёт панели известный ток покоя. Обрыв – ток падает до нуля (неисправность); КЗ – ток растёт. Без него панель не контролирует линию.
tech: Value and tolerance are on the drawing or panel manual (typical 1–10 kΩ); never substitute a 'close' value.
It sits in the LAST device of the line, not in the panel.
Measure the line resistance from the panel end with all devices connected before power-up and record it.
eng: The panel thresholds (normal / alarm / fault) are set by design around this value; a wrong value can hide an open circuit or create false faults.
In addressable loops the EOL is usually not required (the loop is digitally supervised); check the panel type on the drawing.
Power rating is small (0.25–0.5 W) because supervision current is a few mA.
chk: No parallel 'extra' resistors left from testing
mis: EOL fitted in the panel so a cut wire is not detected
Two EOLs in a branched line

b: A relay is a switch operated by a small coil current so a low-power control signal can switch a separate, often higher-power or electrically separate circuit.
Реле – переключатель, управляемый малым током катушки: слабый сигнал управления коммутирует отдельную, часто более мощную или гальванически развязанную цепь.
tech: Coil terminals (A1/A2) and contact terminals (11/12/14, NO/NC) are different groups – never mix them.
Check coil voltage (24 V DC, 230 V AC…) against the drawing before energising.
Fire-alarm relay modules (e.g. addressable output modules) also carry a loop address – set per the address list.
eng: Interposing relays separate the controller output (low current, sensitive) from field loads and give galvanic isolation between systems.
Contact rating must suit the load and its type (inductive loads need derating or a suppression element).
Fail-safe philosophy: decide whether the safe state is relay de-energised (normal for shutdown functions).
mis: Load wired through the coil terminals
Missing coil suppression diode on DC relays where the drawing shows one

b: Protective devices that open the circuit on overload or short circuit so cables and equipment do not overheat or burn. The rating is chosen in design to protect the cable downstream.
Защитные аппараты, отключающие цепь при перегрузке или КЗ, чтобы кабели и оборудование не перегрелись. Номинал выбран проектом под защиту кабеля ниже по цепи.
tech: Never replace with a higher rating to 'stop tripping' – the cable is then unprotected.
Check the tripping characteristic letter (B, C, D) and the rating against the single-line diagram.
After a trip, find the cause before resetting.
eng: Selection: rating ≥ load current and ≤ cable current-carrying capacity; characteristic matched to inrush (motors, LED drivers).
Selectivity: upstream and downstream devices must coordinate so only the faulty branch trips.
Breaking capacity must exceed the prospective short-circuit current at the installation point.
ref: IEC 60898 / IEC 60947 series (LV switchgear) – clause not verified

b: Terminals give a numbered, inspectable point where cables are joined or distributed. The number on the terminal is the same number in the termination drawing, so anyone can trace a core from device to panel.
Клеммы дают нумерованную, доступную для осмотра точку соединения кабелей. Номер клеммы совпадает с номером в схеме подключения, поэтому любой может проследить жилу от прибора до щита.
tech: One conductor per clamp side unless the terminal is rated for two.
Use the correct ferrule size: a loose ferrule heats up; a crushed one breaks strands.
Keep spare cores terminated on spare terminals or insulated and labelled – never left bare.
eng: Terminal type follows the circuit: screw, spring, disconnect (knife) for test points, fused terminals for field supplies, IS-blue terminals for intrinsically safe circuits.
Cross-section rating of the terminal must cover the conductor size; torque per manufacturer.
Segregation: power, control and instrument terminals in separate groups or boxes.
chk: IP rating of box kept (glands, blanking plugs)
mis: Two different circuits on one terminal
Core numbers not matching the schedule

b: An SPD diverts lightning or switching over-voltages to earth before they reach electronics. It needs a short, direct earth connection to work.
УЗИП отводит импульсные перенапряжения (молния, коммутации) в землю до того, как они дойдут до электроники. Нужна короткая прямая связь с землёй.
tech: Keep earth leads as short and straight as possible (< 0.5 m where practical).
Check the status indicator (green/red window) and replace a tripped module.
Install on the line side of the protected equipment, as per drawing.
eng: Type/class (T1/T2/T3) depends on location in the installation; voltage protection level must be below the equipment withstand.
Coordination between stages needs the specified cable length or decoupling.
For signal lines a separate data-line SPD is used; its rated voltage must suit the signal (e.g. 24 V loops).
mis: SPD after the equipment instead of before
Wrong voltage class for signal lines
ref: IEC 62305 series (lightning protection) – clause not verified

b: The UPS keeps fire alarm, control and communication panels running when the mains fails; the battery size sets how long. Fire-alarm panels also have their own 24 V batteries.
ИБП питает пожарную, управляющую и связную аппаратуру при пропадании сети; ёмкость батареи задаёт время. Пожарные панели имеют и свои батареи 24 В.
tech: Battery polarity and inter-cell links must follow the drawing; a reversed cell destroys the set.
Ventilation: keep the battery room/compartment vents clear.
Record battery date codes at installation.
eng: Autonomy time is a design requirement (often 24 h standby + alarm time for fire alarm); check the calculation against the installed Ah.
Input and output neutrals/earths are defined by the vendor – follow the UPS manual for the earthing arrangement.
Bypass and maintenance switches must be labelled and their position recorded during LOTO.
mis: Earth arrangement not per vendor manual

b: Protective earthing gives fault current a path back to the source so protection trips and exposed metal cannot stay live. Bonding keeps all metal at the same potential. Instrument/clean earth protects signals from noise.

Защитное заземление даёт току КЗ путь к источнику, чтобы сработала защита и металл не оставался под напряжением. Уравнивание держит весь металл под одним потенциалом. Инструментальная земля защищает сигналы от помех.
tech: Earth conductors are green/yellow; never use them as a working conductor.
Every tray section, box and panel door needs its bonding jumper; paint under the lug must be removed.
Cable shields: earth at ONE end (normally the panel/marshalling end) unless the drawing says otherwise.
eng: TN-S system: separate N and PE; PE sized per the protective device and cable (project calculation).
Main earth bar, instrument earth bar and lightning down-conductors have defined connection points – do not cross-connect on site.
Earth resistance values and test method are in the project spec; record test results per earth pit.
mis: Shield earthed at both ends (ground loop)
Tray joints relying on bolts only
ref: IEC 60364 series (LV installations) – clause not verified

b: CTs and VTs scale high current/voltage down to safe values for meters and protection relays. A CT secondary must never be open-circuited while primary current flows.
ТТ и ТН понижают большие токи/напряжения до безопасных значений для приборов и защит. Вторичную обмотку ТТ нельзя размыкать под нагрузкой.
tech: Short the CT secondary at the test block before disconnecting any instrument.
Check polarity marks (P1/S1) against the drawing – reversed CTs make protection and metering wrong.
Earth the secondary at one point only.
eng: Ratio, class (measuring vs protection, e.g. 0.5 vs 5P) and burden must match the relay/meter design.
VT secondary fuses/MCBs protect the wiring; their rating is design data.
Primary injection or ratio test is part of commissioning per the ITP.
mis: Two earth points on the secondary
ref: IEC 61869 series (instrument transformers) – clause not verified

b: Copper power cable with PVC insulation and sheath, no armour (Г), flame-retardant in bundles (нг(A)) and low smoke (LS). Used inside buildings on trays and in conduits where mechanical protection is given by the route.
Медный силовой кабель с ПВХ изоляцией и оболочкой, без брони (Г), не распространяющий горение при групповой прокладке (нг(A)), с пониженным дымовыделением (LS). Внутри зданий на лотках и в трубах.
tech: Letters: В = PVC insulation, В = PVC sheath, Г = no armour, Э = screen, нг(A) = flame retardant category A, LS = low smoke, FR = fire resistant (mica tape).
Minimum bending radius ≈ 10 × outer diameter (check manufacturer).
Core colours: blue = neutral, green/yellow = PE; phases per project convention.
eng: Cross-section is chosen for load current, voltage drop and short-circuit withstand – the schedule value is design data.
Unarmoured cable needs protection where exposed to damage (conduit, covers, height).
FR type is specified for circuits that must work during a fire (fire alarm, smoke extraction, emergency lighting) – do not swap FR and non-FR.
mis: Cable laid without cover in traffic areas
Mixed power and instrument cables on one tray
ref: GOST 31565 (cable fire safety classes) – clause not verified
IEC 60332 / 60331 / 61034 series (fire tests) – clause not verified
Project cable schedule and cable specification

b: Copper power cable with steel-tape armour (Б) and PVC outer sheath (Шв). The armour protects against mechanical damage and is earthed, so it also acts as a screen and fault-current path. Used outdoors, underground and on open trays.

Медный силовой кабель со стальной ленточной бронёй (Б) и ПВХ шлангом (Шв). Броня защищает от механических повреждений и заземляется – служит экраном и путём тока КЗ. Снаружи, в земле, на открытых трассах.
tech: Armour must be earthed at the gland (armour clamp) – an unearthed armour can become live in a fault.
Use armoured-cable glands (double compression); the inner seal grips the inner sheath, the clamp grips the armour.
Bending radius larger than unarmoured cable (≈ 12–15 × D).
eng: Armour earthing at both ends is normal for power cables (it carries fault current); for instrument cables the shield rule is different.
Direct burial depth, sand bedding and warning tape are in the project installation spec.
Where armour enters an Ex area the gland must be Ex-certified and matched to the cable diameter.
mis: Armour cut back and not earthed
Too tight bends at gland entry
ref: Project cable specification and installation spec

b: Copper cable with halogen-free polymer insulation and sheath. In a fire it gives little smoke and no corrosive acid gas, so it is specified in rooms with people and sensitive electronics (control rooms, server rooms). FRHF also keeps working in fire.

Медный кабель с безгалогенной полимерной изоляцией и оболочкой. При пожаре мало дыма и нет едких газов – применяется в помещениях с людьми и электроникой (операторные, серверные). FRHF ещё и сохраняет работоспособность в огне.
tech: HF sheath is softer than PVC – avoid dragging over sharp tray edges.
Do not substitute PVC (LS) cable for HF where HF is scheduled, even for a short piece.
FRHF cables are marked on the sheath – keep the marking visible at the gland.
eng: HF selection is a life-safety requirement for escape routes and control rooms; LS cable still produces HCl gas.
FR integrity requires the whole circuit (including glands, boxes and supports) to be fire-rated – a non-rated JB breaks the chain.
Termination of FR cables: mica tape must be removed cleanly; follow manufacturer stripping instructions.
mis: Plastic cable ties on FR routes (fall in fire)
FR cable into non-rated junction box
ref: IEC 60754 series (halogen acid gas) – clause not verified

b: Multi-core copper control cable (К) for signals, interlocks and status contacts between panels and field devices. The Э version has an overall screen to keep electrical noise out of low-level signals.
Многожильный медный контрольный кабель (К) для сигналов, блокировок и контактов состояния между щитами и устройствами. Версия Э имеет общий экран для защиты слабых сигналов от помех.
tech: Cores are numbered or coloured – terminate strictly by the core list in the termination drawing.
Screen (Э): earth at one end only (panel side) unless drawing says otherwise; insulate the other end.
Spare cores: terminate on spare terminals and note them.
eng: Core count = signals + spares (typically 10–20 % spare) – a schedule with 7 or 10 cores is a design choice, not interchangeable.
1.5 mm² is the usual control size for mechanical strength and voltage drop on long runs; 2.5 mm² where current or distance needs it.
Control and instrument cables are segregated from power cables by distance or barrier to limit induced noise.
mis: Control cable run with 400 V power on the same tray without separation
ref: Project cable schedule and termination drawings

b: Four twisted pairs for Ethernet (IP phones, cameras, network sockets). Twisting cancels noise; the foil (F) adds screening. Length limit 90 m fixed + 10 m patch cords per link.
Четыре витые пары для Ethernet (IP-телефоны, камеры, розетки). Скрутка подавляет помехи; фольга (F) добавляет экран. Длина линии не более 90 м + 10 м патч-кордов.
tech: Keep pairs twisted to within 13 mm of the RJ45/keystone contacts.
Wiring scheme T568A or T568B – same at both ends (project standard).
Bend radius ≥ 4 × D; no tight cable ties (they deform pairs).
eng: Cat 5e supports 1 Gbit/s; LSZH sheath for indoor fire safety.
Keep ≥ 200 mm from power cables unless metallic separation is used.
Certification test (wire map, length, NEXT, return loss) is the acceptance record.

b: This is the project cable-specification code, not a manufacturer type. The code defines construction (pairs/cores, screen, armour, fire class). The exact decoding is in the project cable specification; check the page for the type shown in the schedule.
Это код кабеля по спецификации проекта, а не марка производителя. Код задаёт конструкцию (пары/жилы, экран, броня, класс пожаробезопасности). Расшифровка – в спецификации кабелей проекта.
tech: Match the code on the drum label to the code in the schedule before pulling.
Pairs (P) and screen (S) in the code tell you it is an instrument/signal cable – treat shields per the one-end rule.
Decoding not available in the app data – NOT VERIFIED here.
eng: Typical structure: JBnn = cable class, 01P/02P/04P = number of pairs or triads, 10/25 = conductor size code, S/J = screening, NM/NK = sheath class. Confirm in the project cable spec; do not assume.
Instrument pair cables: individually and overall screened for 4–20 mA / RTD signals; collective screen for digital contacts.
ref: Project cable specification (needed – not in app)

t: Why this cable, this size, these cores?
Почему этот кабель, сечение и число жил?
b: Type, size and core count on the schedule are design results: type for environment and fire class, size for current and voltage drop, cores for the signals plus spares. Changing any of them on site needs a TQ – not a judgement call.

Марка, сечение и число жил в кабельном журнале – результат проектного расчёта: марка под среду и класс пожаробезопасности, сечение под ток и падение напряжения, жилы под сигналы плюс резерв. Изменение на площадке – только через TQ.
tech: Tag the cable at both ends and at every box exactly as in the schedule.
Pull from the drum listed in the tracker; record metres pulled.
Measure insulation resistance before termination and keep the value.
eng: Segregation groups: HV / LV power / control / instrument signals / IS circuits – separate trays or barriers per project spec.
Derating for bundling and temperature is already in the design size; adding cables to a full tray changes the assumptions.
Length on the schedule includes route plus terminations – a large difference means a route change to report.
mis: Different cable 'because it was in stock'
Length cut short without checking slack at both ends
ref: IEC 60364-5-52 (selection of wiring) – clause not verified

b: Smoke/heat detector reporting to the fire panel over the loop. Each addressable detector has a unique address; the panel knows exactly which room is in alarm and supervises the device.
Дымовой/тепловой извещатель, передающий сигнал на панель по шлейфу. У адресного извещателя уникальный адрес; панель знает, какое помещение в тревоге, и контролирует устройство.
tech: Address must match the address list/drawing – write it on the base and record it.
Base wiring: loop in / loop out polarity marked (+/−); wrong polarity on one base can block the whole loop segment.
Keep dust caps on until commissioning; a dirty chamber gives false alarms.
eng: Spacing and position follow the fire-alarm design (room height, airflow, beams).
Loop isolators split the loop so a short circuit removes only one segment – their position on the drawing matters.
Loop load (number of devices, current) is a panel limit; adding devices needs design confirmation.
mis: Detector fitted before ceiling works finish
Base wired through instead of in/out terminals

b: A loop isolator opens automatically when it sees a short circuit on the loop, so only the faulty section between two isolators stops working. It is why the drawing shows isolators at specific points.
Изолятор автоматически размыкается при КЗ в шлейфе, поэтому отключается только участок между двумя изоляторами. Поэтому на схеме изоляторы стоят в определённых точках.
tech: Direction (loop in / loop out) matters – follow the terminal marking.
Do not move an isolator to a 'more convenient' box; its position defines the protected segment.
Yellow LED usually = isolator active (fault on one side).
eng: Isolator count and spacing come from the rule 'one fault must not disable more than N devices / one zone' in the design.
Isolators add resistance; loop length and device count were calculated with them in place.

b: Sounders and beacons warn people. Their line is supervised by the panel with reversed polarity in standby: devices contain a diode so they stay silent until the panel switches polarity to alarm.
Оповещатели предупреждают людей. Линия контролируется панелью при обратной полярности в дежурном режиме: в устройствах стоит диод, они молчат, пока панель не переключит полярность на тревогу.
tech: Polarity marked on the device – wrong polarity = device sounds in standby or never.
Last device carries the EOL resistor.
Mounting height and visibility per drawing (beacons above door height).
eng: Sound level requirement at the furthest point sets the number of sounders – do not delete 'extra' sounders.
Current draw of all devices on a circuit must stay within the panel output; this is why circuits are split.
mis: Sounder circuit extended with more devices

b: Fire dampers close ducts to stop fire and smoke spreading between rooms. The actuator is driven and supervised by the fire system; end switches report open/closed position back to the panel.
Противопожарные клапаны перекрывают воздуховоды, чтобы огонь и дым не шли между помещениями. Привод управляется и контролируется системой; концевые выключатели передают положение открыт/закрыт.
tech: Two cables are usual: power/control to the actuator and position feedback – terminate each per drawing.
Check actuator voltage (24 V / 230 V) and type (spring-return closes on power loss).
Test manual release before connecting.
eng: Fail-safe: normally-open dampers close on loss of power (spring return) – the control philosophy defines which dampers are NO/NC.
Feedback contacts are used for cause-and-effect and for interlocking ventilation fans.
mis: Actuator fed from the wrong supply

b: Lighting circuits are split by room and by type: normal and emergency (with battery or from a separate supply). Emergency luminaires must light escape routes when the mains fails.
Цепи освещения разделены по помещениям и типу: рабочее и аварийное (с батареей или от отдельного питания). Аварийные светильники должны освещать пути эвакуации при пропадании сети.
tech: Emergency luminaires need the unswitched live (for charging) plus the switched live – 3 or 4 cores; check the drawing.
Mounting and orientation per layout (exit signs face the escape direction).
LED drivers have inrush – do not add luminaires to a circuit.
eng: Lux levels and emergency duration are design values; circuit grouping limits the effect of one fault.
Emergency lighting on FR cable where supplied centrally.
mis: Emergency luminaire on switched live only (never charges)

b: A junction box collects several field cables onto numbered terminals and sends one multicore to the panel. It saves cable and gives an inspection point; every core in and out is listed in the termination drawing.
Коробка собирает несколько полевых кабелей на нумерованные клеммы и отправляет один многожильный кабель в щит. Экономит кабель и даёт точку проверки; каждая жила указана в схеме подключения.
tech: Field cables enter from the bottom or side, never top (water).
IP rating depends on glands, blanking plugs and the lid gasket – all three.
Internal earth bar / shield terminals per drawing; jumpers (bridges) between terminals are design items – fit exactly as drawn.
eng: Power, control and IS circuits in separate boxes or segregated compartments.
Spare terminals and gland entries are design allowances for future cables.
In Ex areas the box, glands and plugs must be certified for the zone and gas group.

b: Structured cabling links every outlet to a patch panel in the telecom cabinet over its own cable. PA loudspeakers run on 100 V lines in series/parallel from the amplifier.
СКС связывает каждую розетку своим кабелем с патч-панелью в шкафу. Громкоговорители СОУЭ работают от 100-В линий усилителя.
tech: Label outlet and patch-panel port with the same ID.
PA line: observe tapping power setting and polarity on each speaker; EOL/monitoring per drawing.
Keep LAN cables away from power and fluorescent ballasts.
eng: PA lines are supervised like fire-alarm lines where used for evacuation.
Patch-panel port map is the as-built record for IT handover.
mis: Speaker tap left at factory default

b: The MCC or VFD feeds and protects the motor; control cables carry start/stop, status and trip signals to the control system. Power and control are always separate cables.
РУ или ЧРП питает и защищает двигатель; контрольные кабели передают пуск/стоп, состояние и аварию в систему управления. Силовые и контрольные цепи – всегда разные кабели.
tech: Check motor nameplate (V, A, connection Δ/Y) against the drawing before connecting.
VFD motor cable: screened/armoured, screen earthed at both ends with 360° gland – different from signal cables.
Rotation check only with the coupling disconnected.
eng: Overload setting = motor FLC; VFD parameters per vendor sheet.
Interposing relays isolate the DCS/PLC outputs from the MCC control voltage.
Local control station (LCS) with lockable stop is a safety requirement for maintenance.
mis: Control and power in one cable

t: Why we test continuity before loop check
b: Continuity proves each core goes from the terminal at one end to the right terminal at the other, with no break and no swap. Finding this before power-up is cheap; finding it during loop check wastes a commissioning team.

Прозвонка подтверждает, что каждая жила идёт от клеммы на одном конце к нужной клемме на другом, без обрыва и перепутывания. Найти это до подачи питания дёшево; при проверке петли – теряется время всей бригады.
tech: Use a low-voltage continuity tester or ohmmeter; a long core reads a few ohms, not zero.
Test core-to-core as well (no cross), and core-to-screen (no short).
Mark each tested core on the schedule copy.
eng: Loop resistance gives an early check of cable length and conductor size.
Record is part of the ITP before termination sign-off.
mis: Testing with devices still connected (false paths)

b: IR test puts a DC test voltage between a core and earth (and between cores) to prove the insulation was not damaged during pulling. A low value means a nick, moisture or a crushed cable that will fail later.

Измерение изоляции прикладывает постоянное испытательное напряжение между жилой и землёй (и между жилами), доказывая, что изоляция не повреждена при протяжке. Низкое значение – порез, влага или пережатый кабель, который откажет позже.
tech: Disconnect both ends; electronics, barriers and surge devices must be off the cable – the test voltage destroys them.
Test voltage: 500 V DC for LV power; instrument/control cables lower per project spec (often 250 V or 500 V).
Discharge the cable after the test; record value, voltage, temperature, date.
eng: Acceptance values are project-specific (spec/ITP); typical minimums are tens of MΩ for LV cables.
Compare both ends' results and the before/after termination values for trend.
Never IR-test fibre or active optical cables; never test a cable connected to a live system.
mis: Wrong test voltage on instrument cable
ref: Project cable installation spec / ITP (acceptance values)

b: A loop check proves the whole chain – field device, cables, junction box, marshalling, I/O card, controller and HMI – works end to end: right tag, right value, right action. Construction proves the wiring; commissioning proves the function.

Проверка петли доказывает, что вся цепочка – прибор, кабели, коробка, маршализация, модуль ввода-вывода, контроллер и HMI – работает насквозь: нужный тег, значение, действие. Строительство подтверждает монтаж; пусконаладка – функцию.
tech: Never bypass an ESD / F&G / interlock during a loop check without the authorised override procedure.
Simulate at the field end, read at the control room, and sign both ends.
4–20 mA: 4 mA = 0 %, 12 mA = 50 %, 20 mA = 100 %; below 3.6 mA = fault.
eng: Construction scope (RHI) ends at mechanical completion; loop checks are a commissioning activity unless the contract says otherwise.
4–20 mA is used because a live zero (4 mA) distinguishes 'zero value' from 'broken wire', and current is immune to cable resistance over long runs.
Intrinsically safe barriers limit energy into hazardous areas; IS circuits use blue cables/terminals and separate earth.
ref: IEC 60079-11/14 (IS and Ex installations) – clause not verified

Подключение – почему сюда и почему этот номер
b: Each core lands on the terminal number given in the termination drawing because that number is where the panel or device expects that signal. The ferrule number on the core is the same number, so the path can be traced without the drawing.

Strip length to the terminal spec; no copper visible, no insulation under the clamp.
Shield: drain wire in heat-shrink to the shield terminal at the panel end; cut and insulate at the field end (unless drawing differs).

Terminal torque per manufacturer; re-check after 24 h for large conductors.

В зонах, где возможен газ, оборудование и кабельные вводы сертифицированы так, чтобы не стать источником воспламенения. Маркировка Ex (d, e, i, группа газа, T-класс) должна соответствовать зоне на чертеже.

faq: Why a diode across a DC relay coil?
Почему диод параллельно катушке реле DC?

When the coil is switched off its magnetic field collapses and generates a voltage spike many times the supply. The diode gives that energy a path through the coil instead of arcing across the contact or destroying the transistor output that drives the relay.

При отключении катушки её поле исчезает и возникает всплеск напряжения во много раз выше питания. Диод даёт этой энергии путь через катушку вместо дуги на контакте или пробоя выхода, управляющего реле.
Why a resistor at the end of a line?
Зачем резистор в конце линии?
It gives the panel a known standing current so a broken or shorted wire changes the current and is reported as a fault. The panel supervises the wiring 24 h a day.
Задаёт панели известный ток покоя: обрыв или КЗ меняют ток и фиксируются как неисправность. Панель контролирует линию круглосуточно.
Why shielded instrument cable?
Зачем экранированный кабель КИП?
Signals of a few mA or mV pick up noise from nearby power cables and motors. The screen catches that noise and sends it to earth at one end, so the reading stays true.
Сигналы в единицы мА или мВ ловят помехи от силовых кабелей и двигателей. Экран собирает помеху и отводит в землю с одного конца, показание остаётся верным.
Why separate power and control cables?
Почему силовые и контрольные кабели раздельно?

Power cables carry high current and switching spikes that induce noise into control signals; mixed circuits also make isolation and fault-finding dangerous. Separate cables and tray segregation keep signals clean and people safe.

Силовые кабели несут большие токи и коммутационные всплески, наводящие помехи в сигналы; смешение цепей опасно при отключении и поиске неисправностей. Раздельные кабели и лотки сохраняют сигналы и безопасность.
Why different numbers of cores?
Почему разное число жил?
Core count = signals needed + spare cores for future or repair. A 7-core and a 10-core cable are not interchangeable – the spare philosophy and terminal layout are in the design.
Число жил = нужные сигналы + резерв на будущее и ремонт. 7 и 10 жил не взаимозаменяемы – резерв и раскладка клемм заданы проектом.
Why terminate the shield at one end only?
Почему экран заземлять с одного конца?

Earth potential differs slightly between two buildings or panels. Earthing both ends lets current flow in the screen (a ground loop) and that current becomes noise. One end gives the noise a drain without the loop. VFD motor cables are the exception (both ends, for EMC).

Потенциал земли в разных щитах немного отличается. При заземлении с двух концов по экрану течёт ток (земляная петля) – это помеха. Один конец отводит помеху без петли. Исключение – кабели двигателей ЧРП (оба конца, ЭМС).
Why different earthing systems?
Зачем разные системы заземления?

Protective earth carries fault current and must trip protection; instrument (clean) earth keeps signal references quiet; lightning earth takes surge current. Mixing them puts fault or lightning current into signal circuits.

Защитное заземление проводит ток КЗ и должно отключить защиту; инструментальная земля держит опорный потенциал сигналов; молниезащита принимает импульс. Смешение заводит ток КЗ или молнии в сигнальные цепи.
Why continuity before loop check?
Почему прозвонка до проверки петли?
A loop check needs a commissioning team at both ends and live systems. Finding a swapped core then costs hours; finding it with an ohmmeter during construction costs minutes.
Проверка петли требует бригаду на обоих концах и включённые системы. Перепутанная жила тогда стоит часов; омметром при монтаже – минут.
Why insulation resistance tests?
Зачем измерение изоляции?
Damage from pulling is invisible from outside. A high DC voltage finds the weak spot now, not after six months when moisture gets in and the circuit trips during operation.
Повреждение при протяжке снаружи не видно. Высокое постоянное напряжение найдёт слабое место сейчас, а не через полгода, когда влага вызовет отключение в работе.
Why different cable glands?
Зачем разные кабельные вводы?

The gland seals the enclosure (IP), grips the cable, earths the armour and in Ex areas keeps the explosion protection. Armoured, unarmoured, Ex d and Ex e cables each need their own gland type and size.
Ввод герметизирует оболочку (IP), фиксирует кабель, заземляет броню и в Ex-зонах сохраняет взрывозащиту. Бронированный, небронированный, Ex d и Ex e кабели требуют свой тип и размер ввода.
Why interposing relays?
Зачем промежуточные реле?

Controller outputs are low-power and sensitive. The interposing relay takes the small signal and switches the field voltage, isolating the controller from field faults and giving the contact rating the load needs.
Выходы контроллера маломощные и чувствительные. Промежуточное реле принимает слабый сигнал и коммутирует полевое напряжение, изолируя контроллер от полевых аварий и давая нужный номинал контакта.
Why 4–20 mA?
Почему 4–20 мА?

Current is the same at every point of the loop, so cable length does not change the reading. The 'live zero' at 4 mA separates a true 0 % reading from a broken wire (0 mA), and the loop can power the transmitter.
Ток одинаков во всех точках петли – длина кабеля не меняет показание. «Живой ноль» 4 мА отличает истинный 0 % от обрыва (0 мА), а петля может питать датчик.
Why intrinsically safe barriers?
Зачем барьеры искробезопасности?

In a gas zone even a small spark can ignite. The barrier limits voltage, current and energy into the field circuit so a fault cannot produce an igniting spark. IS circuits are kept blue and separate for this reason.
В газовой зоне даже малая искра опасна. Барьер ограничивает напряжение, ток и энергию в полевой цепи, чтобы авария не дала воспламеняющую искру. Поэтому ИБ-цепи синие и отдельные.
Why separate marshalling terminals?
Зачем отдельные клеммы маршализации?

Field cables arrive grouped by location; I/O cards are grouped by signal type. Marshalling cross-connects the two so field changes do not need I/O rewiring, and gives a safe test/disconnect point for every loop.
Полевые кабели приходят по месту; модули ввода-вывода – по типу сигнала. Маршализация соединяет их, чтобы изменения в поле не требовали перемонтажа I/O, и даёт точку проверки/отключения каждой петли.
Why different protection devices?
Зачем разные защитные аппараты?

Each protects something different: MCB/fuse – the cable from overload and short circuit; RCD – people from earth leakage; motor overload – the motor winding; SPD – electronics from surges. One device cannot do all jobs.
Каждый защищает своё: автомат/предохранитель – кабель от перегрузки и КЗ; УЗО – людей от утечки; тепловое реле – обмотку двигателя; УЗИП – электронику от импульсов. Один аппарат всё не сделает.
